verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of a control over data sent back to New Relic is narrow: the Diagnostics CLI (nrdiag) does not send its collected data to New Relic by default, and uploading is an explicit option. Community-described env vars and Data Management Hub settings for turning off default log forwarding control customer data ingest, not vendor usage tracking, so they are adjacent and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented opt-out of product usage telemetry for the CLI, UI and agents; a general privacy or telemetry settings page; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: By default, this data is not transmitted to New Relic. You do have the option to upload this information to your New Relic account over HTTPS.
